title: land and sync can name different code/<id> branches for one range
goal: backlog.py land derives the code/<id> branch name the way kbgit.py sync does (one shared helper, e.g. kbgit.lane_plan), so a range that begins with a content commit of another id (new task --parent --commit, new bug --commit) is recognised as waiting on its merge request on a re-run; a TestBacklogLand test lands such a story twice before the merge and asserts the second run prints waits for its merge request

run: import pathlib,sys; s=pathlib.Path('_tools/backlog.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); b=s[s.index('def cmd_land'):]; b=b[:b.index(chr(10)+'def ',1)]; sys.exit(0 if 'lane_plan' in b else 1)
